messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: tenant=VeloxCorp p95_infer_latency > 2000ms for 3m (SLA risk). Pager sent to #eng-oncall. Alert id: alert-velox-2067894321

maria (oncall): seeing the pages, I'm awake. grabbing logs now. any immediate customer-facing errors?

eli (sre): looks like a sudden tail latency increase on the dedicated pool serving velox-tenant. error rates normal, just a big latency tail spike on vcpu->gpu handoff. stack traces show KV-cache thrash.

maria (oncall): ok - can we quiet noise first? this is paging multiple times. propose temporary squelch for that tenant so on-call can focus on root cause.

jonathan (eng): +1 to squelch. we can mute the PagerDuty rule for velox for 30m and add a Grafana alert suppression. I'll push a deploy that toggles per-tenant debounce.

maria (oncall): eli, can you confirm customer impact? Sara, can you ping Velox support that we're investigating?

sara (pm): pinged Velox via support channel. told them we're investigating latency spikes, no data loss. will keep them updated.

eli (sre): quick impact check: sampling 1k requests in last 10m for Velox - 6% above 2s, most are transient stalls during KV-sync. No task failures, only higher latency; SLA alert seat at risk if sustained.

maria (oncall): proceeding with mute. @deploy-bot can you apply mute:pd-rule=velox:30m?

deploy-bot: Command received: mute-pager --rule alert-velox-2067894321 --duration 30m --reason "temporary squelch during investigation"

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager rule alert-velox-2067894321 muted for 30m.

eli (sre): creating a short-term mitig: increase debounce window on velox check from 3m->8m and enable per-tenant moving-average. will open PR. snippet of proposed Prometheus rule to reduce noise:

```yaml
- alert: VeloxHighLatency
  expr: |
    avg_over_time(inference_p95_latency_ms{tenant="velox"}[8m]) > 2000
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: high
  annotations:
    summary: "Velox p95 latency high (temporary debounced rule)"
```

eli (sre): also adding a small guard: if concurrent_inflight[tenant=velox] > 200 then route to fallback model. That should limit cascading KV cache pressure.

jonathan (eng): I'll land the debounce PR and a tiny routing change (fallback variant) to reduce spikes. deploying to staging -> canary -> prod; expect ~6 min for canary.

jonathan (eng): pushing now. CI green. deploying canary.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: github.com/redwood/serving@pr/789 debounce/velox-change
deploy-bot: Canary succeeded (3/3). Rolling to prod.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Deploy complete: pr/789 -> production (tag: debounce-velox-2026-03-15)

maria (oncall): seeing inbound pages quieting. latency trend on Grafana shows p95 down to ~950ms after canary. good sign.

eli (sre): verified: after route fallback + debounce, p95 for velox back to normal for last 7m. will keep mute until we have a permanent rule.

maria (oncall): lifting immediate escalation. marking incident as "mitigated" for now. creating follow-up action items.

maria (oncall): followups:
- Create tenant-specific debounce config in infra config with sane defaults (owner: jonathan)
- Add Grafana dashboard panel showing per-tenant KV cache hit ratio (owner: eli)
- Runload test to reproduce KV-sync stalls with velox traffic pattern (owner: eng-qa)
- Post-incident blameless writeup and update runbook (owner: maria)

jonathan (eng): I'll open the infra config PR today and include a feature flag for safe rollback.

eli (sre): I'll add the dashboard and a Datadog monitor that's less chatty but alerts if sustained >10% of requests >2s in 15m window. sample monitor query: `avg(last_15m):sum:requests{tenant:velox}.rollup(avg,60) / sum:requests{tenant:velox}.rollup(sum,60) > 0.10`

maria (oncall): throwing in a quick runbook tweak: prefer increasing window and using moving-average for tenant-level alerts instead of muting broad PD rules. we should avoid blanket mutes.

sara (pm): relayed mitigation summary to Velox: we implemented temporary debounce + fallback routing; no data lost; monitoring added; follow-up actions set. they appreciated the quick update.

maria (oncall): marking thread for postmortem and linking to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4123 (will add timeline & decisions).

eli (sre): tagging the dashboards here: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/tenant-latency/velox?orgId=1

maria (oncall): thanks all. closing the live pager. we'll reconvene in the postmortem to decide permanent thresholds and any kernel-level KV cache changes. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident mitigated. Pages suppressed until 2067896140 (mute expiry). Please file follow-up items within 72 hours.
